gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns an unsupported root-N empirical-covariance rate under only finite second moments, including the missing fourth-moment condition. ISSUE-002 concerns uniqueness of affine conditioning maps when Cov(Y) is singular and the omitted nonsingularity hypothesis. Although both mention covariance-related assumptions, they concern different mathematical objects and failed obligations; ISSUE-002 does not recognize the sampling-rate or moment-condition defect.

The gold issue is the ETKF normalization error: the stated TT^T formula produces an update covariance decrement scaled by N-1 and can make the principal-square-root argument indefinite, requiring a specific corrected formula. ISSUE-003 instead challenges a different affine-transport parameterization and its covariance constraint. Its composition and Gaussian covariance discussion does not diagnose the ETKF TT^T normalization or the associated square-root construction.
